tools.name: get_household_status
tools.title: Household budget and orders
tools.description: Use when the user asks how much budget is left, what is booked or on the way, or what Mandat remembers about the household. Returns the spending envelopes, open orders, saved preferences and plans waiting for a yes.

section.description: Limit the answer to one part; omit for everything.

tools.name: set_spending_mandate
tools.title: Set a spending budget
tools.description: Use when the user gives Mandat a budget ("keep it under $400", "$150 a week for groceries") or an auto-approve rule ("buy without asking under $40"). Creates the envelope Mandat must stay inside and the one-time PayPal approval. A new budget with the same purpose and period replaces the old one.

budget.description: Total amount the household allows, in currency units.

period.description: once for a single event, or a recurring envelope.

auto_approve_under.description: Mandat may pay on its own up to this amount per plan; 0 means always ask.

purpose.description: Short name the user will hear, e.g. "In-laws visit" or "Household essentials".

tools.name: remember_preference
tools.title: Remember a household preference
tools.description: Use when the user states a lasting fact about the household: allergies ("Max is allergic to chicken"), brands ("we drink Northbeam medium roast"), access notes. Saved across sessions and applied to every later search.

subject.description: Who or what it is about, e.g. "Max (dog)" or "Coffee".

fact.description: The fact, in the user's words.

tools.name: find_home_services
tools.title: Get quotes from local home services
tools.description: Use when the user needs a service at home: cleaning, catering, plumbing or handyman work. Asks every matching merchant agent in parallel, verifies each agent's signed identity card, and returns up to 5 negotiated quotes, cheapest first. Does not book anything.

need.description: What is needed, in the user's words, e.g. "dinner for six at home".

when.description: Day and time wished, e.g. "Friday before noon" or "Saturday 7pm".

annotations.title: Get quotes from local home services

tools.name: find_products
tools.title: Find household products
tools.description: Use when the user needs things delivered: bedding, pet food, coffee, household supplies. Filters out anything that conflicts with saved household preferences (allergies) and puts the household's usual brand first. Returns up to 5 products with delivery. Does not buy anything.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "dog food" or "queen sheets for the guest room".

tools.name: negotiate_offer
tools.title: Negotiate a quote
tools.description: Use when the user wants a better price or a different slot on one service quote ("can they do better if we take Friday morning?"). Sends one message to the merchant's agent and returns the updated quote. The merchant never goes below its own floor.

ask.description: What to ask the merchant, e.g. "Friday morning for $80?".

tools.name: propose_plan
tools.title: Propose a plan to approve
tools.description: Use once the options are chosen. Groups them into one plan with the price breakdown (base, negotiated discount, fees, tax, total), checks it fits the budget, and says whether it is under the auto-approve rule. Returns a confirmation_token. Moves no money. If needs_user_yes is true, read the total aloud and ask the user to say yes.

mandate_id.description: Which budget pays; omit to use the household's recurring envelope.

note.description: Optional note for the household, e.g. "for the in-laws visit".

tools.name: confirm_plan
tools.title: Confirm and place payment holds
tools.description: Use only after the user explicitly said yes to a proposed plan (or when propose_plan said it is under the auto-approve rule). Places one PayPal authorization hold per item; nothing is captured until the service is done. Idempotent: calling it again for the same plan returns the same receipt and never pays twice.

user_confirmation.description: The user's own words of approval, e.g. "Yes, book it". Required when propose_plan returned needs_user_yes.

tools.name: change_order
tools.title: Change a booked order
tools.description: Use when plans change on a booked service: a new date, a new time or a new number of guests. Asks the merchant's agent. If the merchant declines, Mandat voids that payment hold at once and returns replacement options to propose.

order_id.description: order_id from a receipt or get_household_status.

tools.name: close_order
tools.title: Pay, cancel or refund an order
tools.description: Use when a service is done (capture: pays the merchant, a lower final bill captures less and releases the rest), when the user cancels before it happens (cancel: voids the hold), or for money back after payment (refund, full or partial). Needs the order's close_token from its receipt.

amount.description: For capture: the final bill if lower than the hold. For refund: the amount back; omit for a full refund.

confirmation_token.description: close_token of this order, from its receipt.

annotations.title: Pay, cancel or refund an order

tools.name: refresh_card
tools.title: Refresh a Mandat card
tools.description: Used by Mandat cards to refresh their content. Not for the assistant.
